name: Nuage DB
description: Nuage DB, Memoire's own database in Rust: tables on disk behind a write-ahead log, branches, backups to S3-compatible storage, an HTTP API and a management console at /admin.

NUAGE_TOKEN.description: Token of the database API (clients send it as a bearer token).

NUAGE_BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket for the backups. The dyno's disk is erased at each restart: the data comes back from here.

NUAGE_BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint URL (leave empty for AWS).
